clue.text: Chases after red dogs

indicators.note: the second piece is placed after the first in the answer

parts.note: blood is red, so the colour stands for it
to hound someone is to chase them persistently

explanation.surface: Hunting dogs pursue a fox or deer after the red of blood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chases' reads as the verb of the sentence, but it is a piece; 'after' puts it behind the red colour word.
explanation.definitionFit: These are a breed of tracking dog famed for their scent-following noses.

clue.text: Burst because too much food was packed in

definitions.meaning: a sudden bursting, as of a tyre

definitions.text: too much food was packed in
definitions.meaning: an informal word for a huge, gorging meal

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a tyre puncture and, informally, a lavish feast.

clue.text: Circular tour-or part of it

parts.note: a bit is a part or piece of something

explanation.surface: A round trip, or just a section of it.
explanation.definitionFit: A path travelled round and round, like a planet circling the sun, is a circular tour.

clue.text: Reinforce a point on the journey back

definitions.meaning: to make an argument hit home forcefully
literally steering a car back to your house

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom for emphasising an argument and literally means motoring back to your house.

clue.text: No friend can gain a stone!

parts.note: O is the figure nought, meaning none
a pal is a friend

explanation.surface: Someone without friends hopes to acquire a gem.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an iridescent gemstone, and gems are called stones.

clue.text: Odd notion of the French at about midday

indicators.note: odd means strange, so the letters of the word are rearranged oddly

parts.note: de is French for of

explanation.surface: A strange French idea around lunchtime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Odd' rearranges NOTION to NOONTI, then DE, French for 'of', ends it.
explanation.definitionFit: An old poetic word for noon, the middle of the day.

clue.text: Get free

parts.note: read as obtaining something without paying, to take it, or to land a bargain

explanation.definitionFit: To take without paying is to get something for nothing, and a bargain is also called this.

clue.text: Top soldier puts force on to blameless individual

parts.note: a para is a paratrooper
g is the symbol for gravitational force
taken as written

explanation.surface: A senior soldier applies pressure to an innocent person.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down answer pieces stack from the top, so 'Top' merely sets the paratrooper first.
explanation.definitionFit: A model of excellence or virtue is a person without fault.

clue.text: Perhaps I can wash the slicer

indicators.note: perhaps suggests these letters might be arranged in another way

explanation.surface: Maybe I could clean the cutting tool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perhaps' rearranges the eight letters of I CAN WASH.
explanation.definitionFit: A powered toothed tool that cuts through timber is a kind of cutter.

clue.text: Go with Bobtail in some way or another, he's indispensable

indicators.note: says the letters are arranged some other way

explanation.surface: Travel with a short-tailed animal, which you cannot do without.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in some way or another' rearranges GO and BOBTAIL together.
explanation.definitionFit: In music the term marks an accompanying part that must not be omitted, so it is obligatory.

clue.text: Three might be a suitable number

definitions.note: read as something that numbs, an anaesthetic, not a figure

indicators.note: might be suggests the letters could be rearranged into another word

explanation.surface: Three could be an appropriate figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'might be' rearranges THREE. 'number' looks like a figure but is something that numbs.
explanation.definitionFit: An early anaesthetic gas that deadens feeling, so it numbs the patient.

clue.text: Loophole for a retail shop

definitions.meaning: a way of escape or release
a store selling goods, as a factory shop

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a vent or means of escape and also a store selling a maker's goods.

clue.text: Fat, thanks to fifty down!

parts.note: ta is informal British for thanks
L is the Roman numeral for fifty
low means depressed or down

explanation.surface: Someone's weight is blamed on fifty being depressed.
explanation.definitionFit: Rendered animal fat used for candles and soap.

clue.text: It carries the current most active member

definitions.meaning: an energetic, lively person in a group

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means a charged electrical cable and, idiomatically, an energetic person.

clue.text: It's right to present up-to-date promise to a child

parts.note: AD, anno domini, counts years up to the present date
a vow is a promise
a son is a child

explanation.surface: A modern pledge made to a youngster.
explanation.walkthrough: In Church of England law this is the right to nominate a clergyman to a parish living.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the patron's legal entitlement to nominate a priest to a church benefice.

clue.text: Agreed on a type of drink

indicators.note: a type of the letters, that is a version of them in another order

explanation.surface: Consensus reached about a kind of beverage.
explanation.definitionFit: A fizzy citrus soft beverage.

clue.text: We threw up after finding most of an ant in best vegetarian dish

indicators.note: the reversed piece comes after the rest
the shortened insect goes inside the word best
most of a word means losing its last letter
in a down clue threw up means the word is read upwards, backwards

explanation.surface: Someone is sick after discovering part of an insect in a meat-free meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' trims ANT to AN, set 'in' BEST; 'threw up' turns WE into EW.
explanation.definitionFit: A casserole of pulses is a meat-free main course.

clue.text: Criticised the scene shot in the long grass

indicators.note: the scene is shot into the grass, placed inside it

parts.note: a reed is a tall grass
a view is a scene

explanation.surface: A film critic pans a scene filmed in tall grass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shot in' reads as filming, but it places the scene word inside the grass word.
explanation.definitionFit: To assess a film or book critically in print.

clue.text: Menorca might be the place for a love affair

indicators.note: might be suggests the letters can become something else

explanation.surface: A Balearic island could be where a holiday fling happens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'might be' rearranges MENORCA, a Spanish island.
explanation.definitionFit: A romantic relationship.

clue.text: Evolution theorist might repair about half the wing

indicators.note: the mending word goes round the other piece

parts.note: to darn is to mend fabric

indicators.note: the first half of the word is taken

explanation.surface: A scientist might fix part of a damaged wing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'might' and 'the' are links; the scientist's surname is defined by his famous theory.
explanation.definitionFit: Charles, the naturalist who proposed natural selection.

clue.text: Governor of a Greek province tells a number to walk

parts.note: to march is to walk in step

explanation.surface: A provincial official orders a number to parade.
explanation.definitionFit: The head of a nome, an administrative district of modern Greece.

clue.text: Doctor in heated row with nut who got overheated in the haystack

indicators.note: heated means agitated, so the letters are stirred up

parts.note: MB is a Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree

explanation.surface: A physician in a hot argument with a madman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heated' rearranges MB, ROW and NUT together.
explanation.definitionFit: Of hay, spoiled by fermenting heat while stacked.

clue.text: Turnover from a hundred leaving the Cup Final

definitions.note: read as the verb phrase turn over

indicators.note: the hundred leaves the word, so it is removed

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
the end is the final part

explanation.surface: An upset as a hundred depart the cup final.
explanation.definitionFit: To tip something so it stands on its end.

clue.text: Silver, the French took before lunch, was shining brightly

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
le is French for the
a.m. means the morning, before noon

explanation.surface: A Frenchman's silverware gleamed in the morning.
explanation.definitionFit: Glinting with light.

clue.text: Keen to agree, possibly

indicators.note: possibly suggests the letters may be put another way

explanation.surface: Eager to concur, perhaps.
explanation.definitionFit: Keen and enthusiastic are synonyms.

clue.text: Quarter, as found in the outskirts of Egypt

indicators.note: the word as is found inside the other letters
the outskirts of a word are its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A district on the edge of Egypt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quarter' looks like part of a city, but here it is a compass point.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the four cardinal points of the compass.

clue.text: It's right, in a feature, on Norwegian

indicators.note: the right letter goes inside the facial word

parts.note: the nose is a facial feature

explanation.surface: A feature article about a man from Norway.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective for the language and people of Norway.

clue.text: London square is the scene of a battle

definitions.meaning: the London square with Nelson's Column

explanation.definitionFit: It names both the square in central London and Nelson's naval victory of 1805.

clue.text: Basic characteristic required from a parachute?

definitions.meaning: a parachute must bring you safely back to the ground

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means sensible and unpretentious, and literally describes descending to the ground.
